=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- .github/actions/claude-pool-token/post.js:9-16 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: path.dirname(poolDir) returns a normalized path without a trailing slash, whereas process.env.RUNNER_TEMP may contain a trailing slash. If RUNNER_TEMP has a trailing slash, the path.dirname(poolDir) !== runnerTemp comparison evaluates to true, skipping pool directory cleanup.
  WHY: On runner environments where RUNNER_TEMP is defined with a trailing slash, the action logs "CLAUDE_POOL cleanup skipped reason=pool_dir_invalid" and leaves the directory containing sensitive Claude OAuth token files on disk after the job completes.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:293-295 and 309-312 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The claims.repository_owner and claims.job_workflow_ref checks are case-sensitive, unlike the repository check on line 300 and line 303 (repository.toLowerCase()).
  WHY: GitHub preserves caller casing in job_workflow_ref. If a workflow call reference uses mixed casing (e.g. Shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/.github/workflows/...), workflowRef.startsWith(WORKFLOW_PREFIX) throws a 403 Refusal("wrong_workflow"), rejecting valid Actions jobs.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1506-1517 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root hook .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py lacks the literal-ID loop exemption that was added to workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py, causing it to return DECISION_ASK on loop counter expansions.
  WHY: In CI, tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py imports the root hook and tests its behavior directly; 11 loop tests (such as test_literal_id_read_loop_is_allowed and test_unvetted_loop_keeps_no_decision) fail with assertion errors, failing the tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and lint CI jobs.
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:82-88 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: In GitHub Actions (GITHUB_ACTIONS=true), when broker_url is empty (unconfigured default), line 84 evaluates [[ "" == "https://claude-pool-broker.shubhodeep.workers.dev/v1/pool" ]] to false and immediately calls "finish false broker_url_invalid" before line 88 ("finish false broker_not_configured") can be reached.
  WHY: When the broker URL is unconfigured in an Actions environment, the script emits reason=broker_url_invalid instead of the documented and expected reason=broker_not_configured, preventing callers and diagnostics from identifying an unconfigured broker state.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Root hook and template hook parity (test_template_parity in tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:1018 must pass).
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py around lines 1506-1520.
  Evidence of absence: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py was modified to add "and not _LOOP_HEADER_RE.match(command)", but .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py was left unchanged. In CI, test_gh_api_write_guard.py fails on test_template_parity due to the diff between the root hook and template copy.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
